## Key Projects

### 1. GrindLens
- Type: Full Stack Web Application
- Public URL: https://grindlens.dev
- Repository: Private repository per project owner
- Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL
- Description: LeetCode practice tool that tracks submissions, highlights patterns to practice, and schedules revision. Includes community-reported company questions filtered by company, topic, and difficulty.

### 2. RTRP Chat Rooms (Open Chat)
- Type: Real-time Communication Application
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/Open_Chat_Application
- Live Demo: https://open-chat-application-ubti.onrender.com
- Technologies: Node.js, Express.js, Socket.IO, JavaScript
- Description: In-memory real-time chat application supporting up to 100 users per room without a persistent database. Automatically cleans up rooms and disconnected user states.

### 3. LeetCode Discord Reporter
- Type: Automation Service / Discord Bot
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/leetcode-discord-reporter
- Technologies: Python, GitHub Actions, Discord Webhooks, LeetCode GraphQL API
- Description: Automated bot running on GitHub Actions and cron scheduling. Automatically queries accepted LeetCode submissions and posts daily performance summaries to Discord every night at 10:15 PM IST.

### 4. Social Follower Graph (C)
- Type: Console Application (C)
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/Social_Media_Follower_System_C
- Technologies: C, Adjacency Matrix, File I/O
- Description: A console follower system in C with follow and unfollow operations, mutual-follow suggestions, and file persistence (users.txt and follows.txt). Users are kept in an array and connections in an adjacency matrix. An educational prototype with a fixed maximum user count.

### 5. Midnight Network
- Type: HTTP Service Monitor
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/midnight-network
- Live Demo: https://midnight-network-8m4w.onrender.com/
- Technologies: Python, Flask, SQLite, Docker
- Description: HTTP service monitor. Checks each service on an interval, stores results in SQLite, opens an incident on failure, and closes it on recovery. Single worker, no authentication or alerts.

### 6. NPTEL IoT Study Dashboard
- Type: Interactive Educational Web Platform
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/nptel-iot
- Live Demo: https://nptel-iot.vercel.app
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Description: Assignment-practice dashboard for NPTEL Introduction to IoT, with immediate answer feedback and original assignment PDFs.

### 7. LeetCode Grind Tracker
- Type: Progress Tracking Dashboard
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/leetcode-grind-tracker
- Technologies: Python, MySQL, PHP, JavaScript
- Description: The predecessor to GrindLens: a submission sync script querying alfa-leetcode-api, MySQL views for topic and streak breakdowns, a PHP JSON endpoint, and a four-tab dashboard.

### 8. Dead Packet Detective
- Type: Network Forensics Workbench
- Repository: https://github.com/Harshith1702/dead-packet-detective
- Technologies: Python, Sockets, HTTP
- Description: Probe-based network-forensics workbench that collects DNS, ping, TCP handshake, and route evidence for a hostname or IP. Explicitly designed without packet capture or PCAP analysis.

## Open Source Contributions
- Rocket.Chat: Contributed TypeScript parser fixes and unit tests across PR #39455 (timestamp parsing), PR #39737 (defensive tests for isNodeOfType), and PR #39733 (emoji handling in reducePlainTexts), which maintainer ggazzo reviewed and consolidated into batch PR #39853 (https://github.com/RocketChat/Rocket.Chat/pull/39853).
